title: Counting Lights Along the Coast
transcript:
People living near Sandbay beach are being invited to take part in an unusual evening survey. Instead of counting birds or collecting rubbish, volunteers will record lights that shine directly onto the sand. The project began after a conservation group noticed that several new buildings had bright lamps facing the beach throughout the night.

The group is concerned that unnecessary lighting may disturb animals that feed or rest along the coast. However, it does not want to remove lights needed for safe walking. Volunteers will therefore note whether each lamp lights a path, an entrance, or an empty area. They will work in pairs and use a paper map, so nobody needs a special phone application.

The survey was originally planned for Friday. It has been moved to Tuesday because the restaurants are quieter then, making it easier to distinguish regular lighting from lights used only for weekend events. Volunteers will meet at the harbour office before sunset for a short briefing. They have been told to remain on public paths and not enter hotel grounds to inspect lamps.

After the information is checked, the group will speak to building owners about simple changes, such as pointing lamps downwards or setting timers. A second survey will take place in winter. The aim is to find practical improvements while keeping the coastal paths comfortable and safe for evening visitors.

options: Lights shining directly onto the beach.
The number of birds beside each building.
The opening hours of coastal hotels.
questions.answer: Lights shining directly onto the beach.
questions.explanation: 志愿者要记录直接照向沙滩的灯光，而不是数鸟或捡垃圾。

questions.prompt: Why will volunteers note the purpose of each lamp?
options: To identify lighting that is necessary for safety.
To recommend new places for beach events.
To decide which phone application to buy.
questions.answer: To identify lighting that is necessary for safety.
questions.explanation: 项目不想撤掉安全步行所需的灯，因此要区分照明的用途。

questions.prompt: Why was the survey moved to Tuesday?
options: The harbour office is closed on Fridays.
The beach is easier to reach by bus then.
There is less lighting connected with weekend events.
Volunteers can work without maps that evening.
questions.answer: There is less lighting connected with weekend events.
questions.explanation: 周二餐馆较安静，更容易区分常规灯光与周末活动专用灯光。

options: They must inspect only hotel entrances.
They must turn off every unnecessary lamp.
They must stay on public paths.
questions.answer: They must stay on public paths.
questions.explanation: 志愿者被要求留在公共道路上，不得进入酒店地界检查灯具。
